purpose: Concrete work register for the September 2026 Atlas population pass. It records what should be populated next, how records become usable, and what must remain explicitly unknown.
principles: latest available observation rather than invented current value
project mythology remains distinct from empirical layers

actions: populate latest available World Bank indicators
workstreams.completion_rule: Every canonical country has a stable record and an auditable observation state, even when some indicators are missing.

actions: head-of-state and head-of-government fields where sourced
workstreams.completion_rule: No institution is inferred from a country name alone; each added institution gets a source.
Observed ownership, financing and contractual relationships are separated from policy proposals and hypotheses.
Each infrastructure edge identifies an operator, location or source when known.
Descriptive classification is kept separate from theological truth claims and organizational claims.
No covert relationship is inferred without public evidence.
Company and facility claims require attributable evidence and geography.

actions: resolve local data before external links
workstreams.completion_rule: A user clicking a populated record reaches a useful local entry rather than an empty shell.

quality_checks: relationship endpoints resolve or are explicitly queued
no placeholder text remains in promoted records
